{"relevant": true, "severity": "info", "message": "Good move on httpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Lax in internal/auth/session.go. Since the session now rides in a cookie automatically, check: (1) SameSite=Lax doesn't block cross-site GETs, so keep all state-changing endpoints off GET and add CSRF tokens (or an Origin check) on POST/PUT/DELETE; (2) set a bounded Max-Age/Expires and rotate the session ID on login to prevent fixation; (3) consider the `__Host-` cookie prefix (Secure, Path=/, no Domain) so subdomains can't overwrite it; (4) make sure the old token path (localStorage, response body, or Authorization header) and any logging of the token were removed."}
